Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)
Covers: Head
SP: 16
Armor Penalty: -1 REF, -2 DEX, -2 MOVE

Ablation it suffers is reduced by 1 (minimum 0), and Martial Arts attacks and Special Moves don't halve its SP. Built in: Smart Ears (with Level Damper and Radio Communicator) and modified Smart Glasses with 8 cybereye option slots. Can take Subdermal Armor Cyberware Enhancements. Repairs 1 lost SP at the end of each day it loses none.

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo's penalty is -1 REF, -2 DEX, -2 MOVE. The sheet applies one penalty to all three stats, so it uses -2; add the difference back by hand for the lighter stat(s).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Catalog).
